title: ASCII Text
description: Chữ hiện thành lưới ký tự ASCII theo độ đậm (10 mức), các hàng gợn sóng nhẹ, tô dải màu xanh sang màu nhấn.

moworks.notes: Text rasterised to a grid of mono cells (demo 5 × 7 px at 96 px type; recipe 5–12 px), each cell's coverage mapped to 10 levels ' .:-=+*#%@', glyphs filled with a cyan → accent horizontal gradient. Rows ripple sideways ±3.2 px (sin(0.45·row + phase), 2 waves per 3.4 s), refreshed at 12 fps with ~10 % of cells flickering one level up. Demo reveal: cells switch on left → right with seeded noise over 0.3–1.2 s; dissolve 2.6–3.1 s; loop 3.4 s. Params: cell: cỡ ô (5–12 px) · charset (' .:-=+*#%@') · wave: biên độ gợn (3 px) · fps (12). Cells switch on left to right with seeded noise over 0.3–1.2 s and dissolve 2.6–3.1 s; about one in ten flickers a level up each refresh.
